lead.question: 一架在南太平洋荒岛坠毁26年的轰炸机，为什么第四台发动机仍完好无损？
lead.warmup: 1963年，一架兰开斯特轰炸机坠落在南太平洋的瓦立斯岛——一个位于萨摩亚以西很远、几乎无人踏足的小岛。它损伤不重，却就此被遗忘，在荒草与海风里躺了二十六年。请你先猜一猜：一台露天停放二十六年的发动机，本该锈成什么样子？又是什么把它完整封存了下来？
goals: 熟练运用 have + 宾语 + 过去分词这一使役式，并区别于被动语态
理解并运用 be worth doing、in the meantime、a colony of、turn...into 等本课短语
能按时间线复述1963年坠机、1989年重新发现到包装运回法国并着手修复的全过程
lead.summary: 课文按时间顺序展开：1963年一架兰开斯特轰炸机坠毁于南太平洋瓦立斯岛，损坏不重却被遗忘；1989年它在一次航空勘查中被意外发现。当时状况良好的兰开斯特已属罕见、值得抢救，法国当局让人把飞机包装成部件运回法国。四台默林发动机只需修三台——第四台被蜜蜂做成蜂房，在蜂蜡中完好封存。
lead.tips: 使役式的关键是过去分词：要说 have the plane restored，别写成 have the plane restore；worth 后面只接 doing。

questions.q: What was 'sweet as honey' and why?
questions.zh: 什么东西“像蜜一样甜”？为什么？
questions.a: The fourth Rolls-Royce Merlin engine was sweet as honey — still in perfect condition. A colony of bees had turned the engine into a hive, so it was totally preserved in beeswax.
questions.aZh: 第四台默林发动机依旧完好无损。因为一群蜜蜂把它当成了蜂房，它被完整地保存在蜂蜡里。
questions.hint: 见课文倒数第二句与末句。

questions.q: Where and when did the Lancaster bomber crash, and what happened to the wreck in the following years?
questions.zh: 这架轰炸机何时何地坠毁？之后残骸怎样了？
questions.a: In 1963 it crashed on Wallis Island, a remote place in the South Pacific, a long way west of Samoa. The plane wasn't too badly damaged, but over the years the crash was forgotten and the wreck remained undisturbed.
questions.aZh: 1963年，它坠毁在瓦立斯岛；多年来这次失事被人遗忘，残骸也一直没受到扰动。

questions.q: How was the plane rediscovered in 1989, and why was it considered worth rescuing?
questions.zh: 1989年飞机怎样被重新发现？为什么值得抢救？
questions.a: In 1989 it was accidentally rediscovered in an aerial survey of the island. By that time a Lancaster bomber in reasonable condition was rare and worth rescuing.
questions.aZh: 1989年它在该岛的一次航空勘查中被意外重新发现；到那时状况尚好的兰开斯特已属罕见。

questions.q: What did the French authorities do, and what do the enthusiasts plan to do?
questions.zh: 法国当局做了什么？热心人打算怎么做？
questions.a: The French authorities had the plane packaged and moved in parts back to France, and now a group of enthusiasts are going to have the plane restored. They will need to have only three of the four engines rebuilt.
questions.aZh: 法国当局让人把飞机包装起来、分成部件运回法国；一群热心人准备把它修复，只需修复四台发动机中的三台。

questions.q: The title is 'Sweet as honey!'. What is 'sweet as honey', and why is the title a pun?
questions.zh: 标题指的是什么？为什么是双关？
questions.a: It refers to the fourth engine, still in perfect condition, preserved in beeswax. Literally the engine was sealed in honey-like beeswax; figuratively it expresses the enthusiasts' delight at finding one engine that needed no rebuilding.
questions.aZh: 它指第四台被蜂蜡封存的发动机。字面是蜂蜡封住，比喻上写出热心人的惊喜——竟有一台完全不用修。

exercises.q: 根据课文填空：In 1963 a Lancaster ________ crashed on Wallis Island, a ________ place in the South ________. The plane wasn't too badly ________, but over the years the crash was forgotten and the ________ remained ________.
exercises.a: bomber; remote; Pacific; damaged; wreck; undisturbed

exercises.q: 汉译英（须用 over the years 与 in the meantime）：多年来，这次坠机事件被遗忘了；在此期间，飞机残骸一直没有受到扰动。
exercises.a: Over the years the crash was forgotten; in the meantime, the wreck remained undisturbed.
exercises.note: in the meantime 在此期间。

exercises.q: 根据课文完成句子（注意语态）：Then in 1989, twenty-six years after the crash, the plane ________ accidentally ________ in an ________ ________ of the island.
exercises.note: 一般过去时的被动语态。

exercises.q: 改写句子，保持句意：It was worth rescuing the Lancaster bomber.
exercises.a: The Lancaster bomber was worth rescuing.
exercises.note: be worth doing 主动表被动。

exercises.q: 用 have + 宾语 + 过去分词改写：① The French authorities arranged for someone to package the plane and move it in parts back to France. ② Enthusiasts will arrange for the plane to be restored.
exercises.a: ① The French authorities had the plane packaged and moved in parts back to France. ② A group of enthusiasts are going to have the plane restored.

exercises.q: 根据汉语完成句子（须用 imagine 与 packing cases）：想一想他们拆开包装箱时那种惊奇与欣喜吧！
exercises.a: Imagine their surprise and delight when they broke open the packing cases!

exercises.q: 用所给动词的正确时态与语态填空：Twenty-six years ________ (pass) before the plane ________ (rediscover) in 1989. By then the wreck ________ (not disturb) since the crash and the fourth engine ________ (preserve) in beeswax.
exercises.a: had passed; was rediscovered; had not been disturbed; had been preserved
exercises.note: 过去的过去用过去完成时被动。

quiz.q: 1963年，那架兰开斯特轰炸机坠毁在什么地方？
options: On Wallis Island, a remote place in the South Pacific
On Samoa, a busy island in the South Pacific
On an island a long way east of Samoa
In the north Atlantic, not far from France

quiz.q: 这架飞机在1989年是怎样被重新发现的？
options: It was accidentally rediscovered in an aerial survey of the island.
It was found by a fisherman swimming near the island.
It was dug out of the sand by some enthusiasts.
It was reported by the French authorities.

quiz.q: 课文中 a Lancaster bomber ... was rare and worth rescuing，be worth rescuing 的意思是？
options: It deserved to be rescued.
It was too expensive to rescue.
It was being rescued at that moment.
It could not be rescued at all.

quiz.q: 飞机装有四台默林发动机，需要修复的有几台？
options: Only three of them.
All four of them.
Only one of them.
None of them.

quiz.q: 文中 A colony of bees had turned the engine into a hive 里的 a colony of bees 指什么？
options: A large group of bees living together
A single bee from the hive
A beekeeper's wooden box
A jar of honey

quiz.q: The French authorities had the plane packaged and moved in parts back to France. 句中 had the plane packaged 的意思是？
options: They arranged for someone to package the plane.
They packaged the plane with their own hands.
They were asked to package the plane.
They refused to have the plane packaged.
quiz.note: have + 宾语 + 过去分词。
